scope: Broad product-area sweep for newly published or materially updated Fortinet Community/KB/TAC/support scenarios dated 2026-10-21 through 2026-11-19. Search results are candidate discovery, not automatic lesson sources.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortigate-3 FortiGate technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: No direct recent Community case matching proxy ARP on VLAN interfaces was verified. A proxy-ARP/intra-VLAN article was found but is approximately five months old and was not treated as a recent scenario.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortimanager-27 FortiManager technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: A configuration-retrieval thread has comments dated 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-10 about bulk retrieval and automation. It is not an IPS package/signature API scenario, so it was not used for this lesson.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortianalyzer-6 FortiAnalyzer technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: No recent scenario matching Fluentd Azure Logs Ingestion output profiles was verified. A FortiGate HA remote-log visibility issue is dated 2026-05-26 and is outside the window.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortiswitch FortiSwitch technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: No recent case matching NAC/DPP match-period retention was verified. Older RADIUS CoA guidance was excluded because it concerns a different transaction.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortiap FortiAP wireless technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: No recent Community scenario matching IPv6 controller discovery/CAPWAP management was verified.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortinac FortiNAC technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: No recent legacy FortiNAC 9.4 NetFlow profiling scenario was verified. FortiNAC-F NetFlow material was kept separate and not promoted to a FortiNAC lesson.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortinac-f-57 FortiNAC-F technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: The managed-CA synchronization article is dated 2026-09-22, outside the rolling window, and is unrelated to endpoint fingerprints; it was excluded.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortiauthenticator FortiAuthenticator technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: The FSSO UPN lookup article is dated 2026-09-17, outside the rolling window and unrelated to HA interface separation; it was excluded.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortipam FortiPAM technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: No recent Community scenario matching API-key regeneration and immediate revocation was verified.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortisiem FortiSIEM technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: No recent Community scenario matching the Machine Learning Workbench dataset/training/inference lifecycle was verified.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com/fortisase FortiSASE technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: No recent Community scenario matching global Cloud Security tunnel authentication/idle timeout behavior was verified.

targets.query: site:community.fortinet.com Secure SD-WAN FortiOS technical tip troubleshooting tip after:2026-10-20
targets.result: No recent Community scenario matching monthly member quota and overage steering was verified.

summary.policy: Community items were not used as primary lesson sources. Older/unmatched items are disclosed but not presented as recent scenario evidence.
